verdict.rationale: Zapier's core product model is trigger-based Zaps that run automatically in the background once set up, and evidence (visual builder, CLI, webhooks, polling triggers, workflow API) plus community reports of zaps executing unattended (including one causing unintended mass calendar invites) confirm autonomous background execution actually occurs. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation detailing scheduling/polling intervals and uptime/reliability guarantees for unattended runs.
